narration: [Scripted demo] Rain taps the observatory dome. Mira turns the radio dial, and three clear knocks emerge from the static. She points toward the maintenance path. This fixed scene tests the application; it does not respond intelligently to your action.

discovered_facts: The radio signal contains three knocks.
state_changes.summary: Alex and Mira remain outside the locked observatory. The radio has transmitted three knocks; their source is unresolved. This is a scripted test save.

memory_updates.text: The radio transmitted three knocks outside the observatory.
